en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a formal group of men in long coats and bowler or top hats standing on a rocky slope near a cliff face. Some men stand at the top of a small hill, others at the bottom near a rough wooden structure or shed built against the rock wall. The scene appears to be an official visit or inspection. Printed German text runs vertically along the right margin of the card.
